ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is amended by changing all of the RS-2,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) and RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse
and Multi-Unit Districts symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-H in the area
bound by:

      The public alley next north of and parallel to West Edmaire Street; South Davol Street;
      West Edmaire Street; and the public alley next east of and parallel to South Vincennes
Avenue, to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ___________________________
                                                          Ronnie Mosley
                                                          Alderman, 21st Ward




Common Address:
1700-1756 W. Edmaire Street
